proposedDefects.needs: a mass column in each PLM part table (DE teil.masse_kg, FR piece.masse_kg, ES pieza.masa_kg, UK part.mass_lb) mapped to atelier:massKg with unit conversion, a product-level SHACL-SPARQL shape summing atelier:massKg over atelier:partOf against atelier:massLimitKg on the product, and the product table carrying the limit

proposedDefects.brief: UK OBC board references a DE rail revision that is SUPERSEDED
